corrected_findings.finding: Startup kept waiting after an owned worker exited
corrected_findings.cause_and_disposition: The readiness loop retried connection errors after the child had already terminated, consuming the full admission timeout. Check the recorded process ownership before and after readiness probes, fail with a safe role-specific diagnostic, and retain rollback of only newly started owned roles. This does not identify or suppress the separate Git-identity failure.

Probe up to 200 unique frozen typed classes, preserving status/count/edge/continuation parity even on empty probes; unavailable responses still fail. Regressions cover a valid later class, cross-service disagreement and unavailable status. Preserve the earlier partial journey and bind reused full-inventory evidence by hash.
